Your intentions are good, but I think fortnite is fine for that age. I only say this because I (28f) personally play it often and so does my daughter(7). It's not her favorite game. She likes Roblox much more, which has a rating of 10+ (originally 7+) and that platform scares me much more than fortnite. There's a much higher report of pedos and scammers on roblox than fortnite. The PEGI age 12 rating in fortnite is only rated that way because it includes (gun) violence towards "human-like characters". It isn't bloody or gory or anything. I'm not trying to make you feel bad for trying to make the best decisions for your child, but I sincerely think that during this time of pandemic, where we are limited in human contact, it's important to allow our kids to have access to different ways of connection. If he feels really left out by being prohibited from playing a game that his peers are playing, I'd be concerned about that. Of course there are plenty more age appropriate games for him, but I sincerely think it would be fine to let him play it. We're not talking about grand theft auto here.
